title: Neon Shatter

selected_top_5.reasoning: The main interaction is repeated direct tapping/clicking on spawned objects for score. Although it is more action-heavy than a traditional idle clicker, this is the closest category in the provided universe to the game's central input loop.
The player is effectively defending the bottom boundary from incoming falling targets. Safe targets must be cleared before breaching the lane, which creates a simplified defensive survival structure.

A major part of the experience is the pleasurable feedback from shattering targets: particles, sound effects, glowing visuals, floating score text, and haptics all strongly support a satisfying destruction loop.
The game shares endless-session pressure scaling and score-chase structure with endless runners, even though movement is absent and interaction is tap-based rather than lane navigation.
This is a weak match chosen mainly because of the polished audiovisual feedback. The actual mood is tense and reactive rather than calming, so this fit is low confidence.
